mechanism.name: polymarket_combo_exposure_preserving_collateral_release
mechanism.eligible_inventory_boundary: only independently existing compatible Combo positions already held for another justified reason
mechanism.state_transition: decompose offsetting Combo positions, merge complementary exposure into pUSD, and create residual positions for unmatched exposure
mechanism.statewise_payoff_boundary: the official source explicitly says only recombinable exposure is removed and residual positions preserve the wallet's remaining economic exposure
mechanism.released_principal_boundary: net_pusd_out and final_pusd report released collateral; released pUSD principal is not profit
mechanism.economic_value: earlier access to released pUSD can avoid capital occupancy or fund an independently available positive after-cost use while the unmatched Combo exposure remains

execution_requirements: confirmation before requesting a subsequent plan
official_source_facts.failure_semantics: a failed or stale plan must be discarded and replanned; truncated work requires separately confirmed chunks

zero_network_economic_gate.inequality: net_pusd_out * independently_available_after_cost_annual_rate * usable_days / 365 - monetary_execution_cost - approval_cost - retry_and_truncation_cost - operational_cost - residual_position_exit_increment > 0
zero_network_economic_gate.principal_accounting: do not add net_pusd_out itself to profit because it is unlocked collateral principal

rate_sensitivity_only.reason: illustrative comparator only; it is not a qualified current account rate or a Combo-specific guarantee

next_action.retry_trigger: independently existing owned compatible Combo positions plus explicit account-specific plan-request-only authority and exact positive independently available use of released pUSD
next_action.prequalification: request one plan only, do not execute it, and require positive net_pusd_out, required_pusd_input zero, complete consumed-created residual lineage, nontruncated or bounded chunk count, exact estimated-cost unit, and strict positive conservative inequality
next_action.separate_authority: every approval signature plan submission transaction polling retry or account mutation requires explicit separate authority
next_action.stop: stop before market data because the economic value depends on owned plan output and costs rather than Combo quote or CLOB prices

prohibited_shortcuts: acquiring or restructuring Combo positions solely to manufacture collateral return
counting released pUSD principal as profit
assuming estimatedCost is denominated in pUSD or paid by the user
assuming zero gas fields in one SDK example guarantee zero total cost across wallet types
assuming plan generation proves execution success or that a stale plan remains valid
ignoring residual positions approvals truncation retries latency tax or exit costs
double-counting rank-1 holding yield without exact current eligibility rate duration and independently available capacity
